title: Send Me An Email With The Following Info
description:
1. Please tell me about the painting you have in mind
2. Is there a particular painting of mine that is similar in style to what you have in mind?
3. What size do you need?
4. What is your budget range?
5. Do you have a deadline? If so, when?
6. What time of day works best for our call?
7. Your name and email

title: Put Down A 50% Deposit
description: When you're ready to move forward, you'll put down a deposit and we'll get started!

title: Approve The Initial Design Sketch
description: You approve the initial design sketch, I paint, and then you review the painting and provide feedback until it's finalized.

title: Pay Final 50% And Enjoy!
description: When the painting is completed, I'll send you a preview photo by email. Once the remaining 50% balance is paid, the original artwork will be shipped (fee quoted separately based on location) or available for local pickup (Toronto area).
